aspect: Every life event is an application
description: A birth is not a fact to be recorded but a request to be approved. The PA may amend or issue an ID card only after Israeli approval, and Israel updates its own copy, which is the one that governs permits.
energy_note: Your daughter is born, and then applied for.

aspect: This is more than Oslo provided for
description: Under the accords, a holder of an Israeli-approved ID may reside anywhere in the Palestinian territory, with Israel's authority limited to controlling entry into Israel and passage between the two areas. The registry control exceeds that.
energy_note: A power that outgrew the agreement it came from.

aspect: An unregistered child is an administrative non-person
description: Without registry entry there is no ID, and without an ID there is no school enrolment, no health insurance, no travel document, no permit application and no legal identity.
energy_note: A child who exists everywhere except on the system.

aspect: The children of smuggled sperm are a documented case of exactly this
description: Israel has denied identification documents or legal status to babies conceived from sperm smuggled out of prisons, and those children are denied visits to their imprisoned fathers.
notes: See DET-004 for the practice itself. Over 60 such babies by 2018.

aspect: It means the occupation is administrative before it is military
description: Most days there is no soldier. There is a clerk, a database and a form, and they decide more about the shape of the year than the soldier does.
energy_note: Ruled by a spreadsheet you have no login for.

aspect: EXAMPLE - Bidoon: the people with no number
description: Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank cannot obtain PA travel documents without an Israeli-issued national number, which requires a record in the Israeli civil registry. Those without one are called Bidoon - literally 'without'. The category exists and has a name.
energy_note: There is a word for people the registry never recorded.
